q1_issues.issue: Statements 0-2 assert the REJECTED alternative ("live a hundred years as a rabbit") at top level at STV 1.0 0.99, so the KB gains a living-as-a-rabbit eventuality with its duration and oblique, although the sentence rejects it and it lies inside the same imperative whose main clause is (correctly) sealed under Directive.

q2_gaps: preferential / substitutive "rather than <non-finite clause>, <clause>" — there is no licensed route for recording a rejected alternative without asserting it (imperative sealing covers only the commanded event; the strength-0.0 denial is not a rejection-of-an-alternative; the connective section licenses only cause / purpose / concession / contrast)
notes: The main clause is correctly sealed as (Directive (And …)) with no tense and no addressee minted, and "As" is the surface preposition, so both are licensed. "RatherThan" follows the multiword-connective CamelCase convention but sits at the edge of the four licensed connective senses.
